Subject: BrightCart probe-pack / MAP / handover cadence

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency profile and the sandbox flow. Procurement and the data team want a clear mutual action plan and the exact handoff steps for the evaluation artifacts (prompt pack + ~2k test cases + labeled probe pack).

Key asks from BrightCart:
- Ownership & permitted use: confirmation that assets are for evaluation only, sandboxed.
- Retention: dataset must be deleted after the 30-day trial unless we agree otherwise.
- Access: ephemeral creds for engineers; no persistent export.
- Acceptance gates: run acceptance suite (provided by us) and sign-off within 10 business days after ingest.

Can you send a MAP with milestone dates and an example access procedure? Procurement also asked they’d like the timeline attached to the PO.

Sam
Sam Park
Head of ML Engineering, BrightCart

Subject: Re: BrightCart probe-pack / MAP / handover cadence

Sam — appreciate the clear asks. Attaching a draft MAP and a short handoff playbook. High level plan below (we can firm dates after procurement signals):

Milestones (proposal)
- Day 0 (kickoff): MPA signed by both parties, security questionnaire completed.
- Day 2: Probe pack + prompt pack delivered to sandbox (ephemeral access).
- Day 3–12: BrightCart runs acceptance suite; Redwood provides one triage window per week.
- Day 15: Acceptance sign-off or list of remediation items.
- Day 20: If accepted, we set up a 2-week observational run; otherwise we remove access and trigger dataset takedown.

Access & constraints (summary)
- Assets are delivered into a confined sandbox project / tenant. No external export.
- Keys are short-lived (max 48 hours) and issued by Redwood’s access broker.
- Retention is 30 days post-delivery for the trial; logs retained per the SOC2 policy.
- Prompt packs are licensed for evaluation only; cannot be redistributed — see MAP section 3.2.

Attachments in this message: BrightCart_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP worksheet); probe-pack-sample-instructions.pdf (operational steps).

Link to draft MAP spreadsheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3BrightCartMAP

If procurement wants changes, we can fold them into the MAP and send a DocuSign-ready copy. Proposed kickoff: 2026-10-26 if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Quick technical notes from the engagement side to include in the MAP (for engineers & ops):
- Ingest format: we accept newline-delimited JSON (ndjson). Please keep PII out of the payloads; BrightCart can provide a redacted export.
- KV cache & promptpack: we'll mount the promptpack read-only inside the sandbox runtime; promptpack assets are not persisted outside the sandbox.
- Observability: Redwood will provide token-level cost/latency breakdown for the 2-week observation window.
- Remediation window: if acceptance fails, we provide a single remediation attempt (up to 5 business days) to address infra/format issues.

Operational attachment: probe-pack-sample-instructions.pdf — small checklist for your infra team.

If it helps, we can issue the first set of ephemeral keys the morning of the kickoff so your engineers can smoke-test ingest.
